transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, mostly I came in because I’m tired in a way that just doesn’t make sense. I mean, I can sleep fine, and I keep up with everything at work alright, but... I still feel like I’m running on a low battery before the day even gets going.
Aside from feeling tired, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed lately?

Yeah, I suppose I have. For a long time now, there’s just been this... gray, flat feeling most days. It's like, even the things I used to really look forward to—going fishing, tending to the tomatoes, or going to a church concert—they just feel like items on a checklist now, instead of something I actually enjoy doing.
Roughly how long have you felt this gray, flat feeling most days?
Well, let's see... I'd say it's been going on since I was pulled back into full operational leadership at work. So, that makes it about two years and four months ago now.
During these past two years, have there ever been periods lasting more than two months where you felt back to your normal self?
No, not really. I mean... there hasn't been any stretch of time like that. It's just been pretty consistent since it started.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight over this time?

Yeah, I have noticed some changes there. My appetite has just been... off, I guess, more days than not. I'll get busy at work and just push right through lunch without even realizing I haven't eaten. And then when dinner rolls around, I mostly just pick at my food. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything, but my wife actually pointed out the other day that my pants are looking a lot looser on me.
Looking ahead, how do you feel about the future?

I don't really know. I mean... I haven't given it a whole lot of thought. I guess I don't feel much of anything about it. It just seems like it'll be more of the same—just waking up, logging on for work, and getting through the week. I don't really have any strong feelings about it one way or the other.
How have you been feeling about yourself and your self-worth during this time?

I don't think I've felt particularly bad about myself. I mean, I don't feel like a failure or anything like that. I'm still doing my job and getting things done. I just... I don't know, I guess I just feel pretty neutral about myself, same as everything else. I haven't really noticed any big drop in my self-esteem.
Have you had any trouble concentrating, focusing on your work, or making decisions?

No, not really. I mean, my job takes a lot of focus, dealing with the systems and managing the team, and I haven't had any issues keeping up with it. I'm still able to concentrate just fine and make the calls I need to make at work. I haven't noticed any changes there.
